r: Execute daily custody, settlement, clearing, and reconciliation activities across both the Saudi Capital Market and International Markets.
Process securities settlements, cash movements, and custody instructions accurately and within market deadlines.
Perform daily cash and securities reconciliations and investigate settlement exceptions.
Process corporate actions, dividends, stock splits, rights issues, and other entitlement events for Saudi and International securities.
Monitor failed trades and coordinate with brokers, custodians, counterparties, and internal teams for timely resolution.
Maintain accurate operational records and prepare daily operational reports.
Support client asset protection, operational controls, and regulatory compliance.
Coordinate with Saudi Exchange, Muqassa, Edaa, custodian banks, global custodians, and other market participants.
Participate in UAT, process improvements, and operational projects.

d: The primary function of the Rehabilitation Care Tech is to assist the patients and therapist with Rehab Therapy exercises, activities, restorative care, group sessions and programs. The Rehab Care Tech works as an essential part of the patient care team. As the member who spends most of their time in the presence of the patient, compassion, caring, and excellent human interaction skills are necessary along with excellent communication skills both to and from the patient and family, and to and from the rest of the healthcare team.
